nodes.title:
A name you can
afford to lose.

The small print
is still a choice.

The price of
an ordinary favour.

The last thing
on the menu.

You cannot be
in both places.

Someone has
a bus to catch.

An empty chair
is still an answer.

The first version
is already circulating.

The way home
is still the way home.

Your own
side of the door.

A room
for the next question.

Your name
is on the list.

The right
to turn it over.

A witness
with a casting vote.

Someone says no.
The story has to bear it.

Put the pieces
where they belong.

A break
with an actual end.

A screw
no bigger than a seed.

Dinner has
been here for hours.

The programme
with the bad wallpaper.

One promise
small enough to keep.

The wrong
end of the cable.

A smaller
version of your sentence.

From this
side of the room.

Whose explanation
is it to give?

A lift
is also a conversation.

The end
of the extra hour.

It belonged
to the wrong hand.

An apology
that leaves you standing.

Time belongs
to someone else, too.

The same
small pool of hours.

The things
you take with you.
